This looks really useful, especially having the full research workflow in one place. Love that Arabic support is built in from day one. Congrats on the launch Mostafa 👏 [...] Why we're different 🌍

Every research tool was built in English, for English-speaking markets. Circle Panel is the first built natively for Arabic and English — with proper transcription, RTL support, and 20 Arabic analysis themes.

And unlike tools that just bolt AI onto the side, we ground AI in real user data — verified participants, real sessions, quality-checked responses. Not routine form-filling.

Pricing 💸

Starter $29/mo

Pro $49/mo

Business $119/mo

Coming soon 🚀 — prototype testing, surveys, and a participant panel of vetted experts.

We'd love your feedback — try it free at circlepanel.com and tell us what's missing. Every comment shapes what we build next. 🙏
